what: Instead of the system cursor, six 16×26 pixel arrows follow the cursor in a line, each with a different delay (transition transform 0·.2·.3·.4·.5·.6s), forming a color tail. The first arrow (delay 0) is always at the cursor, and the others gather to the center of a link or button over .5s when on it, trembling every .7s (shake ±10px), and fade out over .3s over hidden areas — the playful cursor of the album special page

options.lags: Delay per arrow (seconds, comma-separated), default 0,.2,.3,.4,.5,.6 — this also sets the count
options.snap: Target selector css, default a, button, [data-fx-part=magnet]
options.hide: CSS for where to hide the tail, default [data-fx-part=hide]
options.--fx-c0 … --fx-c5: Arrow colors (via style) — default gray, --kf-success, --kf-accent, dark accent, --kf-danger, --kf-ink-soft

note: On devices without a pointer (hover false) nothing is created and the system cursor stays. When attached, fx-lac-on is added to html and hides the cursor

from.where: index.html body — original #stalker0~5 (.stalk transition transform .2s, #stalker2 .3s … #stalker5 .6s, #stalker0 0s), hov_ over a·.mouse (moves to center, .5s, svg shake .7s infinite), hide2 over .mouse2
